digo: Mjasasa (northern Digo); Mtsambala (southern Digo); Mshomoro (all Digo)
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, V, VI and ch. 5; Mgombato ('njasasa')

teaser.en: A garden flower from the Americas that escaped and now covers the coast; northern and southern Digo even call it different names.
teaser.sw: Ua la bustanini kutoka Amerika lililotoroka na sasa limeenea pwani nzima; Wadigo wa kaskazini na wa kusini hata huliita kwa majina tofauti.

summary.en: Mjasasa is lantana, a scrambling shrub from tropical America with bright, multicoloured flower heads that has become one of East Africa's worst weeds. Digo has three names for it, which vary between north and south.
summary.sw: Mjasasa ni *lantana*, kichaka kinachotambaa kutoka Amerika ya tropiki chenye vichwa vya maua angavu vya rangi nyingi, ambacho kimekuwa mojawapo ya magugu mabaya zaidi Afrika Mashariki. Kidigo kina majina matatu ya mmea huu, yanayotofautiana kati ya kaskazini na kusini.

about.en:
*Mjasasa* is a dense, scrambling shrub with square, rough stems that often carry small hooked prickles. The leaves are rough to the touch, toothed, and smell strongly when crushed. The flowers grow in small flat heads, and each head changes colour as it ages, from yellow to orange, pink or red, so one bush shows several colours at once. The small berries are green at first and turn shiny black.

Pakia's informants identified it by its leaves, flowers and fruits. It is one of the few wild plants that Digo speakers recognise from its flowers, because the flowers are valued for decoration.
about.sw:
*Mjasasa* ni kichaka kinachotambaa na kusongamana, chenye mashina ya pembe nne yanayokwaruza, mara nyingi yenye miiba midogo yenye ndoano. Majani yanakwaruza ukiyagusa, yana meno pembeni, na hutoa harufu kali yakifinywa. Maua huota katika vichwa vidogo bapa, na kila kichwa hubadilika rangi kadiri kinavyozeeka, kutoka manjano hadi machungwa, waridi au nyekundu, kwa hiyo kichaka kimoja huonyesha rangi kadhaa kwa wakati mmoja. Matunda madogo huwa ya kijani mwanzoni na hugeuka meusi yanayong'aa.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa majani, maua na matunda yake. Ni mojawapo ya mimea michache ya porini ambayo wasemaji wa Kidigo huitambua kwa maua yake, kwa sababu maua hayo huthaminiwa kwa mapambo.

where.en: It grows along roadsides, field edges, fallow land and forest margins, and forms thickets that crowd out other plants. Originally from tropical America, it is now found throughout the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Hukua kando ya barabara, pembezoni mwa mashamba, kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa na pembezoni mwa misitu, na hutengeneza vichaka vinavyosonga na kuisukuma nje mimea mingine. Asili yake ni Amerika ya tropiki, na sasa hupatikana kote katika pwani ya Kenya.

uses.en: The Mgombato dictionary describes it as a plant with medicinal leaves. Pakia counts it among the ornamental plants valued for their flowers. The leaves and unripe berries are poisonous to livestock, and the plant is widely treated as an invasive weed.
uses.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inaueleza kuwa mmea wenye majani ya dawa. Pakia anauhesabu miongoni mwa mimea ya mapambo inayothaminiwa kwa maua yake. Majani na matunda mabichi yana sumu kwa mifugo, na kwa kiasi kikubwa mmea huu huchukuliwa kuwa gugu vamizi.

names.en: Lantana shows how Digo names vary within Digo country. Pakia records *mjasasa* in the north and *mtsambala* in the south, while *mshomoro* is known to all Digo speakers. *Mjasasa* is shared with Swahili, and *mshomoro* with Duruma and Giriama. Mgombato spells it *njasasa*. The English names are lantana, devil's weed and tick berry.
names.sw: Mjasasa unaonyesha jinsi majina ya Kidigo yanavyotofautiana ndani ya nchi ya Wadigo. Pakia anarekodi *mjasasa* kaskazini na *mtsambala* kusini, wakati *mshomoro* linajulikana na wasemaji wote wa Kidigo. *Mjasasa* linashirikiwa na Kiswahili, na *mshomoro* na Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Mgombato analiandika *njasasa*. Majina ya Kiingereza ni *lantana*, *devil's weed* na *tick berry*.

conservation.en: Lantana is a declared invasive species in Kenya and much of the tropics. It spreads quickly because birds eat the berries and drop the seeds.
conservation.sw: Mjasasa umetangazwa rasmi kuwa spishi vamizi nchini Kenya na katika sehemu kubwa ya nchi za tropiki. Huenea haraka kwa sababu ndege hula matunda yake na kudondosha mbegu.

reason.sw: Lantana viburnoides, wa jenasi hiyo hiyo

reason.en: Blue porterweed, another flower valued for decoration
reason.sw: Blue porterweed, ua jingine linalothaminiwa kwa mapambo

reason.en: Bougainvillea, an ornamental named alongside it
reason.sw: Mbogenvilia, mmea wa mapambo unaotajwa pamoja nao

reason.en: Yellow oleander, a poisonous ornamental hedge plant
reason.sw: Oleanda ya manjano (yellow oleander), mmea wa mapambo wenye sumu unaotumika kama ua wa nyumba

mgombato: njasasa (-) type of plant with medicinal leaves: lantana (Lantana camara); aina ya mti wenye majani yanayotumika kama dawa.
